title: The Prompt Issue
description: Reference images, original image prompts and working notes. A practical collection of 165 editorial studies.

chapters.title: Portraits & Light
chapters.intro: Faces, gestures and the way light shapes a mood.
chapters.openerNote: Follow the light from a quiet studio gesture to the warmth of a passing moment.

chapters.title: Winter
chapters.intro: Snow, shearling and layers made for the cold.
chapters.openerNote: Let snow, soft light and layered textures set the pace.

chapters.title: Folk & Landscape
chapters.intro: Embroidery, adornment and portraits rooted in place.
chapters.openerNote: Read the story in embroidery, flowers and the landscape beyond the figure.

chapters.title: Fantasy & Period
chapters.intro: Imagined worlds, historical details and romantic atmosphere.
chapters.openerNote: Enter imagined worlds through costume, ornament and atmosphere.

chapters.title: Runway
chapters.intro: Tailoring, movement and silhouettes in stride.
chapters.openerNote: Watch how a step changes the line of a coat, a skirt or a complete silhouette.

chapters.title: Knitwear & Layers
chapters.intro: Tactile knits, playful proportions and considered layers.
chapters.openerNote: Look closely at the dialogue between knit patterns, layers and contrasting textures.

chapters.title: Studio
chapters.intro: Controlled backdrops and graphic clothing studies.
chapters.openerNote: Let a controlled backdrop reveal the shape and detail of an outfit.

chapters.title: Night & Lifestyle
chapters.intro: Interior stories, after-dark light and everyday scenes.
chapters.openerNote: Move through lamplit interiors and city evenings, where setting carries the mood.

chapters.title: Street & City
chapters.intro: Candid settings, urban textures and personal style.
chapters.openerNote: Find the character of a look in the buildings, paths and passing scenes around it.
